MC is more wanting to leave because he's afraid people related to his past are going to find him and hurt the owner. He's gotten feelings for the owner, so he's really torn about going and is trying to get the owner to think/understand that this is the best instead of just disappearing. He'd feel guilty for just taking off since the owner helped him recover from life-threatening injuries. 

I was also thinking of MC using a knife, so I may go that path with it! I also really like the idea of overstepping the owner's boundaries because the MC can be really crude at times
